chapter: Team Magma Space Center raid (perimeter watch)
cap_confirmation: driver state reported level_cap 84; all four members at offset -1 = L81 = cap + offset - 2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Mind Badge earned, Space Center raid, before the Seafloor Cavern. pool-84 adds only Seafloor Cavern / Underwater / Cave of Origin species over pool-76, all excluded. Incineroar 36, Urshifu-Rapid 42 (Kubfu Route112), Swampert 36 + Swampertite stone-window 14, Great Tusk 42 (Route111 ruins), Landorus 42 (Route111 ruins sign - reachable legend), Gholdengo 48.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Salandit Fake Out buys Seviper its Coil turn
Corrosion Toxic on a Steel/Poison target
Bastiodon Sturdy + Metal Burst returns a big hit

attempts.party: party_raid84.json (Incineroar / Urshifu-Rapid / Mega Swampert / Great Tusk / Landorus / Gholdengo)
attempts.why: Salandit's Fake Out flinched Urshifu turn 1 while Seviper Protected my Fake Out, so the plan's opener half-worked - but Seviper never Coiled: the AI withdrew it on turn 2 for Rapidash, which ate a 207 Knock Off, and Surging Strikes broke Salandit's Sash and killed it. Turn 3 Aqua Jet finished Rapidash and Knock Off killed the returning Seviper after its Poison Jab poisoned Incineroar. Bastiodon Protected turn 4 (Weakness Policy fired through the 25 percent Unseen Fist hits) and died turn 5 to three critical Surging Strikes before Metal Burst ever fired.

strategy_checks.evidence: turn 1 Fake Out flinched Urshifu, but Seviper chose Protect that turn and was withdrawn on turn 2; Coil was never used
Salandit chose Fake Out then Sludge Wave (died before it resolved); no Steel target was on the field
Surging Strikes' three hits broke Sturdy and killed Bastiodon on turn 5; Metal Burst never chosen (Protect on turn 4)
Aqua Jet contact on turn 3 did not burn (30 percent)

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked Fake Out (real), but Salandit's own Fake Out turn was meant to be Seviper's Coil turn, so the guard cost the room its setup
cut Surging Strikes to 54 and blocked Knock Off (real)

protect_summary: 2 Protects, both blocked something. Seviper's is strategically empty: Protect on the turn the partner Fake Outs is the room's opener wasted.

ai_defects.board: Salandit 194/194 Sash and Seviper 235/235 (-1 Atk) versus Incineroar and Urshifu, both full
ai_defects.chosen: withdrew Seviper for Rapidash, which took Knock Off for 207 of 254 on entry
ai_defects.better: Seviper Coil (the plan) or attack; switching the setup piece out into a Knock Off to clear Intimidate gave the player a free 80 percent on Rapidash and brought Seviper back later with no boost. Switch-to-reset-Intimidate is over-valued here.

ai_notes: Salandit correctly Fake Outed the faster attacker. Rapidash chose Will-O-Wisp into the Fire-type Incineroar's slot on turn 3 - the driver's chosen record shows target 2 (Urshifu) and Rapidash died before moving, so no defect is claimed from the record.

level_changes.why: won attempt 1 with zero faints; the opener piece died turn 2
never Coiled, killed by one Knock Off after switching back in

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5: first-try 4-0 with zero faints. Bastiodon and Rapidash keep -1; the two setup pieces go to 0.
cooler: The guard-post concept reads (poison lizard, coiling snake, shield wall, horse) but nothing fired: Metal Burst is the memorable piece and it needs Bastiodon to survive a big hit first, which multi-hit Water attacks deny. Cooler: give Bastiodon Wide Guard as the plan text already describes ('Soundproof-free Wide Guard') - the authored set does not actually carry Wide Guard, so the plan and the moves disagree. Suggestion only.
legality_notes: Plan text says Bastiodon holds Wide Guard; the set is Metal Burst / Iron Head / Rock Slide / Protect. Sets are legal; the prose is stale.
verification_limit: The +1 on Salandit and Seviper cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds.
